notes: Parts 17-20 (40 groups) processed; 33 rows emitted. Merged groups: 'melius' + 'ramp veterans' + 'ex ramp engineers' = one Melius row ($25M total = $20M Series A led by CRV + earlier $5M seed from General Catalyst; row records the $20M Series A). 'luxor' + 'bitcoin mining firm' = one Luxor Technology row. 'mogul' + 'real estate investing platform' = one Mogul row. 'rapidapi founder' + 'mickey haslavskys' = one enso row (Mickey Haslavsky is enso's founder/CEO; Forbes Israel item is the same $15M MoreTech-led Series A). Not emitted (already stored in data/rounds.json with the same amount): 'supa' (Supa £21M seed, stored as $28M on 2026-11-06). 'three aussie startups that' (part 19): the resolved URL points to the Nov 6 SmartCompany round-up (Future Secure AI, i14, Indrus) which is already stored; the Oct 2 '$18.75 million' round-up itself could not be read and no lookup was spent (Australian). No row emitted for that group. CONFLICT: Future Secure AI stored $82,000,000, SmartCompany (Nov 6) says US$80 million (AU$115.3 million); difference is small, no row re-emitted. Jedify: Ynetnews item dated 2026-10-06 but the $24M Series A press coverage (SiliconANGLE, Pulse 2.0) is dated 2026-06-10, outside the 120-day window. Row kept with the true date and exclude_reason 'not-funding' (stale re-coverage) so the parent can drop it. Basalt Health: press release dated 2026-09-24 (before the backfill window); HQ sources conflict (Nashville TN vs New York), Nashville used. Nirva: TechCrunch did not name the lead; Preqin/other outlets say co-led by Lightspeed and South Park Commons. lead_investors left empty, both listed as investors. Causa Prima: company employs people in Madrid and Munich; Munich used as HQ (Munich Startup covered its pre-seed), medium confidence. 'startup' group also contains a Business Insider item ('This startup raised $21 million to clean up the AI agent mess') which is most likely the Opsin $21M round, not Causa Prima; it was not attached to a row. Scimplify HQ (Bengaluru, IN) and Rein Security HQ (Tel Aviv, IL; also has a New York office) are from the articles' context plus general knowledge, not an explicit HQ span. Ozlo marked is_ai_ml=false (sleep earbuds, no AI claim in sources read). Navra and Mural marked true on self-described 'AI-native' / 'agentic finance' positioning with lower confidence; reviewer may disagree. Ex-OpenAI researcher group: Moneycontrol report of talks only, company unnamed; emitted with exclude_reason 'not-funding'. Several part-file 'ok' texts were wrong pages (performcarenj.org, Wikipedia Firefly, RapidAPI docs, company homepages); lookups were used instead. 25 lookups used (all WebSearch).
